text:
maya_shah: Heads up — CI microbench on PR #18422 failed with a batch_latency regression and kv cache hit drop. cc @sanjay_patel @oliver https://ci.internal/reports/18422
ci-bot: ci-bench: PR 18422 microbench threshold diff: FAIL
- batch_latency_p95: +18% (22ms -> 26ms)
- kv_cache_hit_rate: -12%
logs: https://ci.internal/artifacts/18422/microbench/output.txt
sanjay_patel: on it
oliver: what changed in 18422? I see a batching refactor plus a kv eviction tweak in the runtime
maya_shah: right — main edits: default batch_wait_ms bumped 8->12ms and we added kv_trim_on_idle=true (evict small entries when idle). suspect interaction between trimming and batching coalescing
lina_choi: repro locally in shadow: `./scripts/run_microbench --profile=batch_latency --pr=18422` shows p95 from 22ms -> 26ms for short seqs (~32 tokens)
ben_runtime: grabbed a perf flamegraph from the microbench shadow run. shows CPU spinning in batch_scheduler loop more, and increased time in kv_cache::miss_path on GPU worker thread
oliver: paste perf snippet:
```
  25.4%  runtime   [.] batch_scheduler::attempt_coalesce
  10.1%  runtime   [.] kv_cache::lookup
   7.8%  runtime   [.] kv_cache::evict_small_entries
   6.5%  kernel    [.] autoselect_slow_path
```
maya_shah: plan: revert the kv_trim_on_idle part from 18422 temporarily and rerun CI. if microbench passes, we bisect trimming variants.
sanjay_patel: I can push a quick revert patch and trigger the microbench rerun now
ci-bot: start: rerun microbench for PR 18422 (revert-kvtrim) — build #9023 started
maya_shah: also launching a tiny canary on dedicated to check real traffic, but microbench is the immediate gate
ci-bot: build #9023: microbench results: PASS ✅ — batch_latency_p95 back to 21-23ms; kv_cache_hit_rate restored to baseline
lina_choi: OK that strongly implicates kv_trim. but why would trimming increase latency? my hypothesis: trimming evicts small hot prefixes, reducing prefix reuse that batching relies on, creating more singleton batches
ben_runtime: replay traces with kv_trim toggled shows prefix reuse rate drops 45% -> 28% when trimming enabled. that correlates with more frequent kernel autoselect downshift to slower convolution kernels for cold sequences
oliver: Proposed root cause summary: kv_trim_on_idle aggressively removes small cached prefix entries too soon. that lowers effective kv hit grouping which increases singleton batches and hurts the kernel autoselect heuristics, resulting in p95 spikes. Fix options: make trimming size-aware/time-aware or exempt recently-hit prefixes (hot set).
maya_shah: I'll open a PR to change trim behavior: only evict if last_accessed > 5m && size_bytes < 256. will also add a microbench golden exercising prefix reuse. opening now: https://git.internal/pr/18428
sanjay_patel: good — add a unit test for kv lifetime semantics and a perf test that asserts prefix_reuse_ratio stays within delta
oliver: :thumbsup: assign me to review once CI runs
ci-bot: PR 18428 opened by maya_shah: "kv: smarter trim to avoid hot prefix evictions" — CI pending: https://ci.internal/pr/18428
maya_shah: adding an action item to release checklist: avoid enabling kv_trim toggles without running the prefix-reuse microbench and gating on p95 thresholds. thanks all for the quick bisect and revert.
